oracle.independence: oracle consumes decoded raw current/base/local vectors and token counts; it does not consume production merged gradients or successors

dtype.oracle_arithmetic: the Stage 0-C reference transition with production inputs decoded to Python float values

formula.outer: Stage 0-C Nesterov SGD applied to current and the per-fragment outer state

gates.continuous_fifty_updates: maximum successor relative L2 over exactly 50 consecutive updates of each fragment <= 1e-6
gates.outer_momentum_state: maximum committed outer momentum-state relative L2 over exactly 50 consecutive updates of each fragment <= 1e-6

checker_recomputation: decode at least one pre-update current payload and all four raw proposal payloads, recompute weights merge outer transition, and compare to the committed successor without trusting the packaged production trace
